الأفلام والمسلسلات: يتجمّع الاحتياطي أثن: Movies & series: the buffer builds up while you watch, up to the chosen length, so they keep playing that long without internet. Live channels: the stream arrives moment by moment and can't be fetched ahead, so the app stores a few seconds at the start of each channel and refills them after any stall. If the internet drops, playback continues from the buffer and the app reconnects every two seconds until it's back. The buffer lives in the device's memory, so it may be shorter with 4K.
